description: This file declares the GnssClient class, which provides an interface for sending GPS location data via gRPC in the Android Open Source Project. It includes necessary gRPC and project-specific headers, and defines methods for constructing the client and sending GPS fixes.

classes.name: GnssClient
classes.description: A client class for communicating with the GNSS gRPC proxy to send GPS location data.

methods.name: GnssClient
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the GNSS client with a gRPC channel.

methods.name: SendGpsLocations
methods.description: Method to send GPS location data with a specified delay.
